_doc: Default rules of the software-engineer gate. Regexes are case-insensitive. A phrase counts only in a requirement context (see job_radar/gates/swe.py). alternative_markers: a clause that offers the software background as one option among others ('or similar technical role') does not score. Point gates.software_engineer.rules_file at a copy of this file to change the rules.
requirement_headers: what you bring|requirements?|qualifications?|who you are|you have|about you|must[- ]have|what we(?:'|’)re looking for|skills|your profile|what you(?:'|’)ll need|minimum
other_headers: responsibilit\w+|what you(?:'|’)ll (?:be )?doing|what you will do|the role|about (?:us|the company|the role)|nice[- ]to[- ]have|bonus|preferred|benefits|perks|life at|data foundation|systems and|activation|cross-functional|our stack
